body:
We need to improve our online demo to make it mobile first in React.js

We also should support all best practices on how to make chatting and also also transcribation on device in the browser, by taking best practices from https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery

We also need to double check we fully delivered all requirements of https://github.com/konard/medical-speech-to-text/issues/1, double check all the plan, all available options, devices support and so on. We also need to double check we can support also on device recognition to double check the quality (may be sent to our service for quality check).

And we also need to double check we fix all CI/CD based on failed main runs/workflows.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Improve quality of the system
